name: SizeAgainstObjects
job: Show a product's real size as clean outlines beside everyday objects (hand, mug, phone) drawn to scale from its dimensions, with a toggle to swap the comparison object, so shoppers grasp size without reading centimetres
visitor_action: tap an object chip to change the comparison (arrow keys move between chips); hover or focus the product or object to see exact dimensions
owner_settings: Comparison objects (choose up to 4 from hand, mug, phone, bank card, can, A4 sheet, each with its label)
mobile: product and object sit on one mat below the title, chips in one row that swipes sideways
motion: product rises in, red measure arrow grows, the comparison object slides in and settles with a soft spring while its chalk outline draws itself; switching objects re-draws and resizes everything to the new scale (reduced-motion: everything shown instantly)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: chalk outlines were cut short by non-scaling stroke + dash draw; entrance fill-mode broke the photo blend)
checks.craft: pass (3, after 1 polish pass: no layout jump on first measure, photo backdrop blends into the mat, chip list as full-width rows on wide)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Pattern table: pale kraft cutting mat with fine grid, white chalk-line outlines, one tomato-red measure arrow, matte
notes: Product photo should be tightly cropped on a light backdrop (it is multiplied into the mat); the 375 pipeline shot shows the entrance frozen mid-animation (iframe virtual-time artifact; direct narrow and reduced-motion shots render fully).
